<div class="card-body">
'''Tonnika Sisters''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">トニカ・シスターズ（姉妹）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">2ターンに1回、自分の支配フェイズに、2フォース消費して運命数を2回引くことができる。どちらかの運命数が2なら、場にある武器を2つかアイテムを2つ盗むことができる。トニカ姉妹は何らかのカードの対象になる場合には1人のキャラクターとして扱われるが、移動には2倍のフォースがかかる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-195o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">双子の盗賊にして詐欺師、スパイにしてダブル・エージェント。ブレアとセニの姉妹は持ち前の色香を発揮して社会の底辺に住むカモたちを操ってきた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tonnika Sisters.

'''Card text:''' Once every 2 turns, during your control phase, use 2 Force to draw 2 destiny. If either destiny is 2, steal 2 weapons or 2 devices on table. When targeted, the sisters count as one character, but moving them costs double Force.

'''Lore:''' Twin thieves, con artists, spies, and double agents. Brea and Senni use their charm on marks at the fringe of society.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese treats the sisters as one character when targeted, with double move cost.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tonnika Sisters]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
